name: Marcus Williams
original_name: マーカス・ウィリアムズ
source:
He is a lieutenant who has achieved a lot in a short time and his reputation is growing rapidly.
He has a good personality and is well-liked by his men.
He is a man of great character and is well-respected ...... is the name of the game, but in reality he is a devil who doesn't care what happens to others as long as it satisfies his own needs. He is not very smart, but he has a good head on his shoulders and a quick wit. He also has a certain amount of physical ability.
He used to be an officer in the army, but he got a hypnosis device by chance and he manipulates people around him to make things better for himself.
He loves women, has a strong sex drive, and has a bigger dick than most men.
